title: Bracewell probe possibly lurking in the solar system

tellings.quote: Bracewell took his speculation one step further by considering that such a probe may already be lurking somewhere in the dark recesses of our solar system,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes an idea from a scientist, Ronald Bracewell, from the 1960s: that an alien civilization might send unmanned probes to other stars instead of traveling itself. Michels says Bracewell went a step further and suggested such a probe might already be hiding somewhere in our own solar system, perhaps at the balance points near the Earth and Moon where an object can stay put. If true, an alien probe could be watching us from close by.
